title: Container With Most Water
description:
You are given an integer array height of length n. There are n vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the i-th line are (i, 0) and (i, height[i]).

Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water.

Return the maximum amount of water a container can store.

examples.explanation: The lines at indices 1 and 8 (heights 8 and 7) form a container with width 7 and height min(8,7)=7, giving area 49.

approach: Begin with the widest pair. Its area is limited by the shorter line. Moving the taller line inward reduces width while retaining the same limiting height or worse, so it cannot improve this pair's bound; only replacing a shorter boundary can possibly help. Move a shorter pointer each step (either one on a tie) and track the maximum. Time complexity is O(n), and space complexity is O(1).
